about: Golden queries, one per task need. Each task has a set of plugins that do it (Judgments.json). 'en' states the task; it is also the author's own sentence and the source of the eight translations. 'generated' holds the sentence and the keyword list written by an independent model from the task alone (see 'generator' and QueryPrompt.txt): the sentence is what it would type into a plain language search box, the keywords what it would type into a keyword search box, in order, each added when the results so far are not good enough. 'authorKeywords' are the evaluation author's keyword lists, kept for comparison: they were written after seeing the catalogue. 'native' queries are region specific needs whose best plugins are often documented in that region's language; each carries the native wording and an English one. 'matrixLanguages' lists every language each need is written in: the cross language search evaluation uses 'languages'; the embedding benchmark's language matrix uses them all, including the gis-glossary project's languages (Norwegian Bokmål and Nynorsk, Icelandic, Danish, Polish, Slovenian, Greek, Romanian, Bulgarian, Slovak, Swedish), and Arabic (Modern Standard), translated by Claude; Icelandic and Nynorsk are the least certain. Together they are the languages the plugin aims to serve.
